description: Divides an incoming phasor into as many as eight steps and fires a gate on whichever steps are switched on

params.text: Sets how many of the eight steps the cycle is divided into, 1 to 8 in whole numbers
Attenuverts the steps CV input, -1 to +1
Sets the width of the step gates, from 0% to 100% of a step, with 50% at centre
Attenuverts the gate width CV input, -1 to +1
Raw compares the phasor against the gate width directly; Smart mutes the output when the phasor stops and flips the comparison when it runs backwards, keeping reverse phasors in time
Turns this step's gate on or off; the lamp shows green when the step is on, blue while it plays, and red when the step is beyond the Steps setting

inputs.text: The phasor that drives the steps; each 0-10V cycle is divided into them

outputs.text: A 10V gate on every step whose gate button is on, at the set width
A 10V trigger at the start of each of those gates

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
every step gate starts switched off, so no gates or triggers come out until you switch at least one step on.
